The Grizzlies defeated the Jazz, 110-105 tonight in Utah. Cedric Coward finished with a team-high 16 points along with 11 rebounds and 4 three pointers for the Grizzlies, while Ty Jerome tallied 15 points, 8 assists in the game. Keyonte George recorded 26 points, 6 assists and 3 rebounds. The Grizzlies improve their record to 4-0 with the win, while the Jazz fall to 1-3 for the season.
